resources.string: There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Downloaded songs are saved in Music/Music Box K, where other apps on the phone can see them. Lock-screen controls, if you turn them on, are an accessibility service that draws this app\'s buttons over the lock screen and reads nothing else. Show what is playing in Glance, if you turn it on, hands the song\'s name to Glance on this phone.
Music Box K is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 only. Copyright wander wildwood. It comes with no warranty. Built on CalmMusic by David Ray Wilson, also GPL-3.0.

Shows Music Box K\'s controls on the lock screen while it plays. Only an accessibility service may draw above the lock screen, which is why this is one. It listens only to the system lock screen, and reads one thing there: whether the PIN field is showing, so the controls can make way for it. It reads no other app, and nothing leaves the phone.
Music Box K needs access to music files to play that one
This song is on your music server, and Music Box K has no login for it. After a reinstall the saved password can\'t be read any more. Enter it again under Music server.
Music Box K can\'t read your music
Android isn\'t letting Music Box K read the songs on the phone. Allow music and audio in Music Box K\'s permissions.
